title: Halting within the configuration code bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, $x$ a Boolean input word, and $sp$ a space-bound function. If $N$ uses at most $sp(|y|)$ space on every choice word for every Boolean input $y$, if $sp(|x|)\le S$, and if $N$ halts on $x$ within $T$ steps along every branch, then it halts on $x$ within $2^{K(N)(S+\log_2(|x|)+1)}$ steps along every branch. Here $K(N)$ is twice the encoded chunk width for $N$ plus two, and $\log_2(n)$ denotes $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
